text_block_list.text:
The clash of the century between the 
"Monster" Maruzensky and the "Emperor" 
Symboli Rudolf. Everyone was abuzz with 
predictions of who would win.

The contenders themselves were no 
exception. Baring their fighting spirits, 
sparks flew between the two.

The "Emperor" or the "Monster"— Amidst a 
massive crowd, the battle begins!
